summary: Lets agents create and edit property listings with photos, descriptions, and pricing, publishing changes to every syndicated site at once.
Keeps listing data synchronized with the regional MLS feed so status and price changes reflect correctly everywhere within minutes.
Lets an agent publish upcoming open house times on a listing and lets visitors register in advance to receive a reminder.
Logs every price change made to a listing over its time on market, giving buyers and agents a transparent price history.
Gives a brokerage a board view of every listing's status, from coming soon through under contract to closed.
Lets buyers search active listings by price, bedrooms, and location, saving favorites to revisit as new matches come on the market.
Lets buyers draw a custom boundary on a map and see only listings within that hand-drawn area rather than a fixed radius.
Emails a buyer as soon as a new listing matches their saved search criteria, instead of requiring them to check back daily.
Filters search results to listings zoned for a specific school, pulling boundary data from the local district.
Filters listings by estimated commute time to an address the buyer enters, accounting for typical traffic at their chosen departure time.
Gives a prospective buyer a quick pre-qualification estimate based on income and debt inputs before they submit a full application.
Shows a buyer today's rate across multiple loan products and lenders so they can compare monthly payments side by side.
Lets a borrower securely upload pay stubs, tax returns, and bank statements requested by their loan officer during underwriting.
Estimates the total closing costs a buyer should expect based on loan amount, location, and lender fees before they reach the closing table.
Shows a borrower where their loan application stands in underwriting and what conditions still need to be cleared before approval.
Sends a lease agreement for e-signature to every named tenant and stores the fully executed document with the unit's records.
Reminds property managers and tenants ahead of a lease's expiration date so renewal terms can be discussed with enough lead time.
Walks a tenant and property manager through a shared move-out checklist and inspection used to determine security deposit return.
Applies scheduled annual rent increases defined in a multi-year lease automatically, notifying the tenant ahead of each change.
Verifies a lease co-signer's identity and income before adding them to a lease agreement alongside the primary tenant.
Lets tenants submit a maintenance request with photos directly from their phone, routing it to the right property staff automatically.
Assigns an open maintenance ticket to the nearest available approved vendor and tracks the job through to completion.
Gives property managers a live board of every open, in-progress, and completed work order across their portfolio of buildings.
Schedules recurring preventive maintenance, like HVAC filter changes, across every unit before it becomes a reactive repair.
Automatically notifies a tenant when their maintenance request is scheduled, in progress, or completed without them having to ask.
Hosts an interactive 3D walkthrough of a listed property that buyers can explore room by room from any browser.
Lets a remote buyer schedule a live video walkthrough with an agent, guiding the agent's camera to rooms the buyer wants to see.
Generates a scaled 2D floor plan from a scan of the property, attaching room dimensions to the listing automatically.
Organizes aerial drone footage and photos for a listing, letting agents trim and attach the best shots to the property page.
Digitally furnishes photos of an empty listing with virtual furniture so buyers can better picture the space in use.
Runs a criminal and eviction background check on a rental applicant and returns a compliant report to the property manager.
Pulls an applicant's credit report with their consent and summarizes the score and key factors for the leasing decision.
Contacts an applicant's previous landlords to verify payment history and lease compliance before approving a new application.
Verifies an applicant's stated income against pay stubs or bank data to confirm they meet the property's rent-to-income requirement.
Combines credit, background, and income results into a single applicant score to help property managers rank multiple applications.
Lets tenants pay rent online by bank transfer or card and gives property managers a real-time view of who has paid for the month.
Lets tenants set up automatic monthly rent payments from a chosen account, with an easy way to pause or update it as needed.
Applies late fees to overdue rent balances according to each lease's specific grace period and fee schedule.
Lets tenants and property managers export a full rent payment history, useful for tax records or a future rental application.
Lets roommates each pay their share of the total rent separately while property managers see it recorded as one combined payment.
Pulls recently sold comparable properties to help an agent build a pricing recommendation for a new listing or offer.
Shows median sale price trends by neighborhood over time, helping buyers and sellers gauge whether a market is heating up or cooling.
Tracks the average number of days listings sit on the market in a given area, updated weekly as new sales close.
Estimates the expected rental yield for a property based on comparable rents and the purchase price an investor is considering.
Generates a shareable report on a neighborhood's schools, walkability, and price trends for agents to send to interested buyers.
Captures inbound buyer and seller leads from the website and assigns them to agents based on territory and current workload.
Gives agents a pipeline view of every active client from first contact through closing, with reminders for stalled deals.
Calculates expected commission on each pending deal and reconciles it against the brokerage's payout once a sale closes.
Reminds agents to follow up with a lead or client after a set number of days of inactivity so promising contacts don't go cold.
Lets agents refer a client to an agent in another market and tracks the referral fee owed once that client's deal closes.
Sends purchase agreements and disclosures out for e-signature to every required party and tracks who still needs to sign.
Assembles the required state disclosure forms for a property into a single packet ready for buyer review and signature.
Shows an agent exactly which parties on a transaction have signed a document and sends automatic reminders to the ones who haven't.
Stores a brokerage's standard contract templates so agents start every new transaction from the correct, up-to-date version.
Exports a complete signing audit trail, including timestamps and IP addresses, for a transaction's compliance file.
Guides a home inspector through a standardized room-by-room checklist and captures notes and photos for each item inspected.
Turns an inspector's field notes and photos into a formatted PDF report delivered to the buyer within a day of the inspection.
Estimates likely repair costs for issues found during inspection, giving buyers a starting point for renegotiating with the seller.
Coordinates inspection appointment times between the buyer's agent, seller's agent, and inspector, avoiding lockbox access conflicts.
Tracks whether repairs requested after an initial inspection were completed, scheduling a reinspection to confirm before closing.
